text:
maya: Kicking off Heliotrope activation thread — objective is a pilot live with retention signal within 30 days. Quick sync: confirm stakeholders, success criteria, and immediate risks.

devin: Thanks — Heliotrope stakeholders from the kickoff doc: Asha (PM), Marcos (Infra), Priya (Data). Proposing a 2h technical deep-dive next Tue. Draft timeline: week0 tech onboarding, week1 integration + smoke tests, week2 pilot traffic.

li: Need sample payloads + sequence length histogram before deep-dive. Baseline perf target we discussed: ~200ms p50 on typical requests. If we hit >300ms we flag as latency risk. Can someone pull an anonymized sample by EOD Fri?

oliver: Success criteria (proposal): 1) Pilot handles 5k daily requests without errors >1%, 2) p50 latency <=250ms, p95 <500ms, 3) Quality: automated eval pass rate >= 87% on their golden prompts, 4) Ops: runbook + rollback tested. Thoughts?

nora: Enablement plan: 60m platform training for their engineers + runbook delivered as markdown in the workspace. I'll own the runbook and the training deck. Will include quick troubleshooting checklist and how to read Console dashboards.

maya: Renewal/health note: Finance will want a 6mo ROI narrative — capture expected cost-per-query and projected savings. Early churn risk if onboarding friction >2 weeks or if first-week SLAs missed. Recommend a canary routing plan to limit blast radius.

oncall-bot: Scheduled maintenance notice: infra patching Wednesday 02:00-03:00 UTC — potential short reconnects to Dedicated nodes.

devin: I'll create the calendar invite with agenda + request for sample data. Also adding a config item: feature flag for canary (toggle + % ramp).

li: For private deployment we need KMS access and network peering details from Marcos. I can draft the minimal IAM/KMS checklist and send to him after the deep-dive.

nora: We'll run a weekly CSAT pulse during pilot and capture qualitative feedback after each training. I'll add a short Google form and link it in the runbook.

maya: Concrete next steps: (1) Devin to schedule deep-dive + invite Asha/Marcos/Priya (by EOD today), (2) Li to request sample payloads + sequence lens (by EOD Fri), (3) Nora to draft runbook + training deck (first draft by Wed next week), (4) Oliver to finalize success criteria with Asha. @here any blockers?

oliver: :thumbsup:

devin: On it. I'll ping Asha and book Tue 11am PT.

li: Request sent to Marcos (cc'ed in calendar invite when scheduled).

nora: Will post draft runbook in this thread when ready.

maya: Great — thanks team. I'll maintain the risk tracker and post a short status update after the deep-dive.
